description: Switch the payment processor from Stripe to Adyen for an e-commerce platform processing $10M/month across 100K transactions. The migration must follow: dual-acquire period (both Stripe and Adyen active — route a percentage of transactions to Adyen via feature flag, starting at 5% and ramping to 100%), reconciliation check (compare transaction records between Stripe and Adyen — verify amounts, fees, settlement timing, refund handling), settlement cutover (switch primary settlement to Adyen, verify daily settlement reports), fallback plan (route back to Stripe if Adyen error rate exceeds threshold), and retire Stripe (remove Stripe integration, close account). A rollback plan must exist (route 100% back to Stripe via feature flag). Risk factors: transaction routing errors (double-charge or dropped transactions), settlement timing differences (Adyen vs Stripe payout schedules), fee structure differences affecting margin, and PCI compliance scope. Tools available: Stripe API, Adyen API, feature flags, reconciliation scripts, PCI-DSS compliance tooling, monitoring (Datadog/Prometheus).
